events.body:
## Context

README, SETUP.md and CONTRIBUTING.md describe a GitHub Actions workflow and Cloudflare Pages deploy. The project is now a Worker with KV refreshed by blt-cron (README "Data refresh" already says so). `public/dashboard.js` also mentions the workflow in an empty-state message.

## What to do

1. Replace those sections with the Worker/KV/blt-cron flow.
2. Fix the "midnight UTC" vs "00:03 UTC" mismatch and the dashboard.js copy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `grep -ri "github actions\|\.github/workflows\|cloudflare pages" my-gsoc-tool` shows no stale instructions

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d my-gsoc-tool/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```

---
